\node[font=\small,anchor=south] at ([yshift=0.38cm]group c1r1.north) {(a) Coq at 64K: one run of each policy};

\end{tikzpicture}
\caption{Context size at each agent step in GLM Coq runs, as the runtime estimates it for
comparison with the threshold (dashed); the estimate runs about 15\% above the provider's reported input.
Circles mark the first step that uses a new summary; filled circles, a first action that only read files
or listings. (a)~The first S, A, and K runs at 64K and the first L run, which never reached its 1M limit;
all four passed, and $\ge$ marks a lower bound where a failed request reported no usage. (b)~At 32K, the
S run that compacted and all three K runs; the other S32 run failed after 12 steps. Clusters of circles in
the K runs are summaries replaced after a single step, mostly when the two kept steps were large
(Section~\ref{sec:behavior}).}
\label{fig:trajectories}
\end{figure*}
